status: REVIEWED BY CHAT 22 AUG - NO GPL CODE FOUND. Not a blocker for Sumeet.
evidence:
TECHNICAL LICENCE AUDIT, all seven clones, 22 Aug. FINDING: no GPL or AGPL code is present. Every GPL/AGPL mention in the codebase is a DELIBERATE PROVENANCE NOTE recording that code was NOT copied. Verbatim examples from src/lib/db/schema.ts and the services: "e_invoice_log doctype as reference -- GPL-3.0, no code copied"; "No GPL/AGPL code copied (OpenConstructionERP is AGPL-3.0) -- only domain concepts"; "the concept only -- OpenConstructionERP is AGPL-3.0, no code copied"; "Grafana itself was evaluated and rejected as software (AGPL-3.0)"; "SuiteCRM (AGPL-3.0 PHP monolith) evaluated and rejected".
The 22 ERPNext/Frappe references are all COMPARATIVE, not ported: "matching ERPNext's own control account", "simplification vs ERPNext's fiscal-year scoping", "derivation, not a ported ERPNext/Odoo cash-flow report".
NO GPL licence header in any source file. NO vendored GPL source. Schemas and API shapes are not copyrightable in most jurisdictions; implementations are, and none was copied.
*** SEPARATE ISSUE FOUND, AND IT IS THE REAL ONE: NO REPO HAS A LICENSE FILE. veridian-ui-kit declares "UNLICENSED"; compliance-tracker, projexa and veda-advisors declare nothing. All seven are PUBLIC. No licence means all rights reserved by default, which protects Rajat legally but is currently an ACCIDENT rather than a decision - the same shape as the visibility question. ***
LIMIT OF THIS REVIEW: chat verified FACTS ABOUT THE CODE, not a legal opinion, and is not a lawyer. "No code copied" written as a comment is the author's claim, not an independently verified provenance chain. An acquirer or enterprise procurement team would want that verified properly.
